title: Sales/CS intake: field-capture prioritization matrix and initial scoping map
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Background: Sales and Customer Success (CS) regularly submit enterprise feature requests without consistent fields or urgency markers. This causes lengthy back-and-forth for PMs and engineering, delaying scoping and inflating discovery cycles.

Goal: Deliver a lightweight field-capture form + prioritization matrix that Sales/CS use to bundle similar asks and produce a 2-minute initial scope per request. The deliverable includes: a one-page scoping template, a 4-quadrant prioritization matrix (value vs effort/ops risk), and an automatable mapping from form fields to Linear fields so CS can batch-upload.

Success metrics: 1) Reduce avg time-to-first-scope from 7 days to <=48 hours for enterprise asks. 2) Increase % of intake items with minimum required fields from ~38% to >=90%. 3) Reduce PM clarification back-and-forth messages per ask from median 3 to <=1.

Scope: Create template and scoring rules; train CS on usage; build mapping spec for future automation (CSV/Drive import or webhook). Out of scope: automating the import pipeline (separate ENG ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Scoping template published in Confluence with examples for three common enterprise patterns (dedicated capacity, private deployment, billing/usage analytics).
Prioritization matrix (value/effort) with scoring rubric documented and validated with two active AE accounts.
CS can produce a completed scoping sheet in <=5 minutes for a single request and a batched CSV for up to 20 requests.
PMs can triage batched intake and assign a quick T-shirt size (S/M/L) and a recommended next step (design spike/eng discovery/legal review).
